title: Existence of finite and integral exceptional coefficient stages
statement: Fix a prime l, a closure Ω of Q_l, a finite-field datum D with l ≠ D.p, finite-type D.k-schemes X and Y, and a separated finite-type D.k-morphism f:X→Y, without absolute separatedness of X or Y. There exists a RingStageAssembly l Ω D hl f [def-sf-ring-stage-assembly-data]. Thus finite and integral operations and normalized ring scalars/mates are constructed, with shift-compatible realizations, but no rational operation, closed operation, field comparison or compactification refinement is constructed.

source.place: Lemma 5.22, Construction 5.25, Propositions 5.24 and 5.26; original coefficient-stage construction steps 1--4

proof.text: Bound the dimension of the compactification middle scheme using its finite-type morphism to the base field, including the empty case. Obtain the finite exact adjunctions from exists_sfFiniteExceptionalOperations. Compose their literal left realization with the inverse finite proper/open presentation comparison and their right equality with the specified-c exceptional presentation. The published sfFiniteExceptional uses the compactification selected from HasCompactification, which need not be c. Compare its left compact support with that for c by the existing unbounded compactification isomorphism, transport the c-adjunction across it and use right-adjoint uniqueness. Whisker this isomorphism by the site and intrinsic-coordinate comparison functors to obtain finiteRight. Lift the ambient shift through the full inclusion using CommShift.ofComp; reflect triangulatedness through the inclusion. Give the right adjoint its adjoint shift, which supplies the unit/counit shift equations and exactness. This constructs every finite Operation, left realization, finiteRight and leftShift.

Use preservation and right-adjoint existence for the literal ambient integral compact-support restriction. Construct its actual full-subcategory lift, choose its right adjoint by the universal adjunction, and use liftCompιIso for the ambient realization. Inherit the left shift and reflect exactness through the full inclusion, then equip the right adjoint with the adjoint shift. Lift the canonical ambient-to-prescribed-tower realization through the fully faithful constructible inclusion: its mapped hom is exactly the composite of the two realizations, proving integralLeft_normalized. This supplies every integral Operation and realization field.

Case-split RingStage to form the finite/integral operation and left-realization families. Apply the scalar-only theorem to these already constructed families and their proved shift compatibility. It supplies the common endpoint scalars, their finite and integral normalizations, normalized scalar identity records, and the counit-normalized comparisons at every compactification.

Construct scalar composition for any three realized scalar functors: whisker and compose their realization isomorphisms with the ambient tensor associator and the inverse composite realization, then lift through the fully faithful target inclusion. Mapping the lifted hom and cancelling the inverse realization proves ScalarComposition.normalized. The scalar identity record is supplied by the scalar-only theorem.

Package the finite and integral constructions, scalar conclusions, supplied scalar identity and proved scalar composition records and left shifts into RingStageAssembly. Every field is retained; no rational or closed operation or refinement comparison is supplied.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 5.22, Construction 5.25 and Proposition 5.24; explicit finite operations, integral lift/adjoint-shift and realization construction, full-inclusion lifts of tensor associators. Split integral preservation/right-adjoint existence and scalar mates with identity normalization.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_ring_stage_assembly (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{max u v}) (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    {X Y : Scheme.{max u v}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [f.IsOver (Spec (.of D.k))] [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f] :
    Nonempty (RingStageAssembly.{u, v} l Ω D hl (f := f))
